title: Q4T complete text Chat request structure v1
description: All supported text request fields. Required semantic and runtime checks are enumerated by x-q4t; schema validation alone is not admission or execution acceptance.

oneOf.description: PNG/JPEG/static GIF/WebP bytes in canonical base64 or a data URI, or credential-free HTTP(S) under deployment fetch policy.

url.description: PNG/JPEG/static GIF/WebP bytes in canonical base64 or a data URI, or credential-free HTTP(S) under deployment fetch policy.

oneOf.description: Canonical padded standard base64 or exact PNG/JPEG data URL; no network URLs.

url.description: Canonical padded standard base64 or exact PNG/JPEG data URL; no network URLs.

video_timestamps.description: One strictly increasing seconds value per source frame. Omission means 24fps from zero.

x-q4t.template_option_precedence: chat_template_kwargs overrides top level after both are validated
x-q4t.duplicate_keys: reject at every JSON object, including historical argument text
x-q4t.file_inputs: Chat file parts require actual PDF; original text and pages use common preparation, preflight and stored snapshot ownership
